notes: This portable C++ TCK slice subscribes to directed interactions under two adapter-selected object classes, removes one class's subscription through the set overload, then removes the remaining class's directed subscription through the class-scoped overload. It queries the subject through standard HLArequestSubscriptions and checks the IEEE 1516.2-2025 MIM NULL response. Provider package, FOM modules, endpoint, callback configuration, class names, and logical-time implementation are adapter inputs. Portable source uses only official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ APIs and the C++ standard library.
